# Implementation Plan: Ralph Stage Chip + Filter Axis + Vite Sidecar Plumbing

*Generated by `/plan-with-ralph --improve plans/ralph-pipeline-03-ui-chip.md` on 2026-05-19. Ready for `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan .ralph/jobs/ralph-pipeline-03-ui-chip/plan.md --autonomous`.*

## Overview

Plan 03 is the first user-visible win in the ralph-pipeline series: it renders a per-task **RalphStageChip** in every command row (`TaskCommand`), adds a **10-chip stage filter axis** to the toolbar, and extends Vite to **serve / inline** `plans/overview-ralph-state.js` for both dev and static builds. After this plan ships, opening the viewer (dev OR static) shows the stage chip on every Ralph-tracked task, and clicking a stage chip in the toolbar filters both the command list and kanban view.

**Worktree:** `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan` creates the worktree at `D:\harness-efforts\codexu\.ralph\jobs\ralph-pipeline-03-ui-chip\worktree\` on branch `ralph-pipeline-03-ui-chip`. All file edits in this plan happen in that worktree; commits land on the branch and merge to `main` after Phase 6 review converges. **Do NOT edit `main` directly.**

**Position in DAG:** depends on Plan 01 (types + sidecar emission). Independent of Plan 02 (watcher) — without Plan 02, users manually re-run `pnpm sync-ralph-state` + browser reload; with Plan 02, HMR auto-refreshes.

**Parallel-work guardrail (Plan 02):** Plan 02 (branch `ralph-pipeline-02-watcher`, executed by sibling crew member `watcher-worker`) also edits `tools/overview-viewer/vite.config.ts`. To minimize merge conflicts, Plan 03 confines its vite.config edits to a NEW named plugin `overviewRalphStatePlugin()` registered alongside (not inside) `overviewDataPlugin()`. Plan 03 must NOT touch Plan 02's `configureServer` extensions and must NOT call `server.watcher.add(...)` for the ralph sidecar — Plan 02 owns the watch and emits `overview-ralph-state:update`.

## Research Findings

### Codebase Context

- **Stack:** React 19 + Vite 8 + Vitest + Radix UI Tooltip/Dialog. Viewer is `@codexu/overview-viewer` under `tools/overview-viewer/`. All files are `.tsx` / `.ts` — **not Svelte**.
- **Types already exist** in `tools/overview-viewer/src/types.ts` (Plan 01): `RalphStage` (union of 10 values), `RalphPipelineState`, `OverviewRalphState`, `getOverviewRalphState()` (returns `window.OVERVIEW_RALPH_STATE` or an empty fallback at lines 83–89).
- **Sidecar files already emitted** by `scripts/lib/sync-core.mjs`: `plans/overview-ralph-state.js` (with `window.OVERVIEW_RALPH_STATE = …;` wrapper) and `plans/overview-ralph-state.json`.
- **Filter system** at `tools/overview-viewer/src/utils/filters.ts`: `FilterAxis` union (currently `status | workstream | cadence | size | scope`), `createEmptyFilters`, `cloneFilters`, `matchesTaskFilter`, `matchesKanbanFilter`, `getTaskSearchHaystack`. `matchesKanbanFilter` today only checks workstream + query (intentional — kanban is narrower).
- **Vite plugin pattern** at `tools/overview-viewer/vite.config.ts` (108 lines): `overviewDataPlugin()` (lines 18–87) is the template — `configureServer` middleware + `transformIndexHtml` inlining with `</script` escape. Plan 03 mirrors this pattern in a sibling plugin.
- **Initial-load mechanism:** `tools/overview-viewer/overview.html` currently loads only `<script src="./overview-data.js"></script>` before `/src/main.tsx`. **Without adding a sibling `<script src="./overview-ralph-state.js"></script>` tag, the initial render in both dev and static build will see empty Ralph state until an HMR event arrives.** This was missing from the original Plan 03.
- **Test split:** `vitest.config.ts` has two projects — node SSR (default, `src/__tests__/**` excluding `interactions/`) and jsdom (`src/__tests__/interactions/**`). Radix hover/focus tests **must** live under `interactions/`.
- **Build commands:** `pnpm overview` (dev, port 5173), `pnpm overview:build` (static), `pnpm --filter @codexu/overview-viewer test` and `typecheck`.

### Technical Constraints

- **`matchesTaskFilter` signature change is fan-out heavy.** Two test files call the filter helpers directly (`searchHaystack.test.ts`, `urlFilter.test.ts`) and need `NO_RALPH_STATE` appended at every call site. Two additional test files (`commandList.test.tsx`, `kanban.test.tsx`) do not call the helpers directly but render React components that will gain a required `ralphState` prop, so their JSX render call sites must pass `ralphState={NO_RALPH_STATE}`. `useMultiAxisFilter.ts` is the in-app consumer and also forwards `ralphState`. See the two test-update subsections under "Files to modify" for the explicit per-file enumeration.
- **Static bundle size budget is TIGHT.** `plans/overview.html` is currently ~495,245 bytes. The ralph sidecar adds ~3,352 bytes plus the new chip component + CSS + filter logic. Set explicit threshold = **525,000 bytes** (~512 KiB) to give a clear margin and define the verify command exactly as `wc -c plans/overview.html`.
- **Plan 02 watcher boundary.** Plan 02 emits `overview-ralph-state:update` via chokidar inside its own `configureServer` extension. Plan 03 must NOT register a second watcher on `plans/overview-ralph-state.js` (the original plan's "defensive watch" was a Plan-02 conflict).
- **Radix `Tooltip.Trigger asChild` + plain `<span>` is keyboard-invisible.** The chip element must be focusable: either give the `<span>` `tabIndex={0}` or use a `<button>` element. Pick `tabIndex={0}` + `role="button"` + cursor styling — `WorkstreamPill` uses an `<a>` trigger that is already focusable, but we have no destination URL.
- **Tooltip slug content has nullables.** `RalphPipelineState.jobSlug`, `groupSlug`, `lastUpdatedAt` are all optional. Tooltip must render gracefully when any are absent (no "undefined" leaking into DOM).
- **App.tsx state pattern.** Use `useState(getOverviewRalphState)` (function ref form) so `setRalphState(getOverviewRalphState())` inside `reloadRalphState` triggers a re-render. A bare `const` won't.

## Approach

### Architecture

**Filter axis composition.** Add `'ralphStage'` to `FilterAxis`. Extend the three predicate functions (`getTaskSearchHaystack`, `matchesTaskFilter`, `matchesKanbanFilter`) with a new **non-optional** `ralphState: OverviewRalphState` parameter. The call site always passes either real ralph state (from `getOverviewRalphState()` — guaranteed non-null) or `NO_RALPH_STATE` (from `testData.ts`). No optional/undefined paths.

`useMultiAxisFilter` gains `ralphState` as its third parameter and includes it in memo deps. The hook's return **object** is also extended in this plan to expose `filters` (alias of `activeFilters`) and `setFilters` (the raw `setActiveFilters` state setter) alongside the existing `activeFilters`, `query`, `setQuery`, `toggleFilter`, `visibleTaskIds`, `visibleKanbanTaskIds` keys. This is required up-front because Plan 04 (`plans/ralph-pipeline-04-pipeline-overview.md` line 58) already consumes `filters` and `setFilters` from this hook. The return shape stays a named-property object — do NOT switch to a tuple. `App.tsx` calls `useMultiAxisFilter(data, taskIdFilter, ralphState)` and threads `ralphState` down through `CommandList` → `TaskCommand` → `RalphStageChip`. `Toolbar` does NOT need `ralphState` as a prop — its `FILTER_GROUPS` list is static; it only needs the new entry.

**Vite plugin separation.** Add a **new named plugin** `overviewRalphStatePlugin()` to `vite.config.ts`, registered in the `plugins: []` array immediately after `overviewDataPlugin()`. Do NOT modify or extend `overviewDataPlugin`. The new plugin:
- `configureServer`: serves `/overview-ralph-state.js` from `plans/overview-ralph-state.js` on disk. **Does NOT add a file watcher** — Plan 02 owns the watch + WS emission.
- `transformIndexHtml`: for static build, locates `<script src="./overview-ralph-state.js"></script>`, reads the source, runs through esbuild minifier, escapes `</script` → `<\/script`, inlines as `<script>…</script>`. Mirrors `overviewDataPlugin`'s pattern exactly.

This physical separation means Plan 02 (watcher extension to `configureServer`) and Plan 03 (new `overviewRalphStatePlugin`) edit disjoint regions of `vite.config.ts` and merge cleanly.

**Tooltip extras slot.** `RalphStageChip` accepts an optional `tooltipExtras?: ReactNode` prop — Plans 07/08 will pass extra rows (notepad, PR/branch links, crew sessions) through this slot without restructuring the component.

Specific known target: Plan 04 currently assumes `useMultiAxisFilter` returns `setFilters` — verify and either expose it now or correct Plan 04's expectation.

    ```ts
    const overviewRalphStatePath = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../plans/overview-ralph-state.js');
    const ralphSidecarScriptTag = '<script src="./overview-ralph-state.js"></script>';

    function overviewRalphStatePlugin(): Plugin {
      return {
        name: 'overview-ralph-state',
        enforce: 'pre',
        configureServer(server) {
          server.middlewares.use('/overview-ralph-state.js', async (_req, res) => {
            try {
              const data = await readFile(overviewRalphStatePath, 'utf8');
              res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/javascript');
              res.end(data);
            } catch (err) {
              res.statusCode = 500;
              res.end(`/* overview-ralph-state.js read failed: ${err} */`);
            }
          });
          // Intentionally NO server.watcher.add — Plan 02 owns the watch + WS emit.
        },
        transformIndexHtml: {
          order: 'pre',
          async handler(html, ctx) {
            if (ctx.server) return html;
            const data = await readFile(overviewRalphStatePath, 'utf8');
            const minified = await transform(data, { loader: 'js', minify: true, legalComments: 'none' });
            const escaped = minified.code.replace(/<\/script/gi, '<\\/script');
            return html.replace(ralphSidecarScriptTag, `<script>${escaped}</script>`);
          },
        },
      };
    }
    ```
  - Append `overviewRalphStatePlugin()` to the `plugins: [react(), singleFile(), overviewDataPlugin(), …]` array.

    ```ts
    export function loadRalphState(): OverviewRalphState {
      const script = readRepoFile('plans/overview-ralph-state.js')

      return windowValue.OVERVIEW_RALPH_STATE ?? NO_RALPH_STATE
    }
    ```

(The bare form used in `App.tsx`'s `reloadRalphState` is fine there because it runs in the browser where `window` is real.)

## Scope

### In Scope

- New React `RalphStageChip` component with Radix Tooltip (focusable trigger, optional `tooltipExtras` slot, null-safe rendering, slug-default dotted-underline variant).
- New `'ralphStage'` `FilterAxis` propagated through `filters.ts`, `useMultiAxisFilter`, and `App.tsx`.
- Kanban filtering by ralph stage (extending `matchesKanbanFilter` with the same predicate — but NOT broadening kanban to other axes).
- 10-entry stage filter group in `Toolbar.tsx`.
- 10 per-stage CSS color variants + `match-slug-default` variant.
- Vite sidecar serving (dev middleware) and inlining (static build) via a new `overviewRalphStatePlugin`.
- `overview.html` script tag for initial-render sidecar load.
- App.tsx HMR subscription to `overview-ralph-state:update` (consumes Plan 02's emission when available; no-op otherwise).
- Test updates for the four impacted existing test files (two filter-helper call sites: `searchHaystack.test.ts`, `urlFilter.test.ts`; two component render tests gaining a required `ralphState` prop: `commandList.test.tsx`, `kanban.test.tsx`) + two new test files.
- Downstream-plan cascade audit (Plans 04–12 + INDEX).

### Out of Scope

- Aggregate Pipeline Overview histogram and click-bar-to-filter wiring → Plan 04.
- `nextCommand` derivation and the "Copy next command" button in `TaskCommand` → Plan 06.
- `injectRalphStagePill` on kanban cards (kanban gets visual stage pills later) → Plan 04 or a follow-up.
- Notepad surfacing, journal links, PR/branch backlinks inside the tooltip → Plan 07 (uses `tooltipExtras`).
- Crew-session list in tooltip → Plan 08 (uses `tooltipExtras`).
- RecentActivity sidebar → Plan 07.
- Broadening `matchesKanbanFilter` beyond ralphStage + the pre-existing workstream/query checks.

## Risk Areas

1. **vite.config.ts merge conflict with Plan 02.** Mitigated by separating into a new named `overviewRalphStatePlugin` registered as a sibling to `overviewDataPlugin`. Plan 03 never touches Plan 02's `configureServer` extension. Plan 03 explicitly does NOT add a `server.watcher.add(...)` for the ralph sidecar (Plan 02 owns the watch + emit).
2. **Initial render with empty Ralph state.** Without the new script tag in `overview.html`, the first render sees `getOverviewRalphState() → emptyState`. Mitigated by editing `overview.html` in this plan.
3. **Filter parameter fan-out.** Five test files and `useMultiAxisFilter` all need updates. Mitigated by adding `NO_RALPH_STATE` to `testData.ts` first and updating systematically.
4. **Concurrent file write during HMR fetch.** `sync-core.mjs` already uses atomic tmp+rename, but transient fetch failures still possible. Mitigated by `.catch()` in `reloadRalphState`.
5. **Static bundle size budget.** Adding ralph sidecar + chip + CSS pushes `plans/overview.html` from ~495KB toward 500KB. Mitigated by explicit threshold (525,000 bytes) and `wc -c plans/overview.html` verification in acceptance criteria.
6. **Radix Tooltip accessibility.** Plain `<span>` triggers are keyboard-invisible. Mitigated by `tabIndex={0}` + `role="button"` on the chip trigger; covered by `interactions/ralphStageChipTooltip.test.tsx` (focus → tooltip shows).
7. **Plan 04 cascade gap.** Plan 04 may reference `useMultiAxisFilter`'s return shape. Mitigated by US-007 audit + updating Plan 04 if needed.

## Acceptance Criteria

**Functional (per-component):**
- [ ] `RalphStageChip` returns `null` when `ralphState.byTaskId[taskId]` is undefined.
- [ ] `RalphStageChip` renders `<span class="ralph-stage-chip stage-<stage>" tabIndex={0} role="button">…</span>` for each of the 10 stage values, with the correct color class.
- [ ] `RalphStageChip` Radix Tooltip shows stage name, `jobSlug` (or `groupSlug` fallback or omitted when both null), and `lastUpdatedAt` (or omitted when null) — no literal `undefined` in the DOM.
- [ ] `RalphStageChip` with `matchSource: 'slug-default'` renders with `border-style: dotted` (verifiable in the chip class list: includes `match-slug-default`).
- [ ] `RalphStageChip` accepts optional `tooltipExtras: ReactNode` prop and renders it inside the tooltip body when provided.
- [ ] `RalphStageChip` trigger is keyboard-focusable: `Tab` reaches the chip and the tooltip appears on focus (verified in `interactions/ralphStageChipTooltip.test.tsx`).

**Functional (filter + integration):**
- [ ] `FilterAxis` union includes `'ralphStage'`.
- [ ] `createEmptyFilters()` returns an object with `ralphStage: Set<string>` (size 0).
- [ ] `cloneFilters(f)` deep-clones `ralphStage`.
- [ ] `matchesTaskFilter`, `matchesKanbanFilter`, `getTaskSearchHaystack` accept `ralphState: OverviewRalphState` as a **non-optional** parameter.
- [ ] `getTaskSearchHaystack` includes `ralphState.byTaskId[task.id]?.stage / jobSlug / groupSlug` in the haystack string.
- [ ] `useMultiAxisFilter(data, taskIdFilter, ralphState)` accepts the new parameter and includes it in memo deps.
- [ ] `useMultiAxisFilter` returns an object with keys `{ activeFilters, filters, setFilters, query, setQuery, toggleFilter, visibleTaskIds, visibleKanbanTaskIds }`. `filters` aliases `activeFilters` and `setFilters` is the raw `useState` setter for the filters state (needed by Plan 04's `<PipelineOverview filters={filters} setFilters={setFilters} />`).
- [ ] `Toolbar` renders exactly **10** stage chips under the "Ralph stage" group.
- [ ] Clicking a stage chip filters both the command list AND the kanban view to tasks whose `ralphState.byTaskId[task.id].stage` matches.

**Vite + static-build:**

## Preliminary Story Decomposition

7 stories, ordered to minimize broken intermediate state. Each story commits and verifies typecheck before the next starts.

- **US-001** — Filter threading + test fixture + minimal App.tsx `ralphState` `useState` so typecheck passes (signature changes only, no UI yet; HMR helper deferred to US-006)
- **US-002** — `RalphStageChip` component + unit + interaction tests
- **US-003** — Wire chip through `CommandList` → `TaskCommand`
- **US-004** — `Toolbar` filter group + CSS (10 stage variants)
- **US-005** — `overviewRalphStatePlugin` in vite.config.ts + `overview.html` script tag
- **US-006** — `App.tsx` `reloadRalphState` helper + HMR `useEffect` + downstream prop threading (state init already landed in US-001)
- **US-007** — Downstream-plan cascade audit + INDEX refresh

(Full story bodies are generated to `stories-outline.md` by the planner — see Appendix B of the planning skill.)

## Suggested Decomposition

This plan is **serial-only**. Every story either depends on the previous one (US-001 unlocks all UI work; US-002 unlocks US-003; US-005's plugin must exist before US-006's HMR helper can fetch the sidecar) or touches shared files (App.tsx, TaskCommand.tsx, vite.config.ts). Parallel execution would force merge thrash on the shared files.

### Cluster: ui-chip-serial
- Stories: US-001, US-002, US-003, US-004, US-005, US-006, US-007
- Phase: 1
- Depends on: None
- File-overlap evidence: shared=`tools/overview-viewer/src/App.tsx` (US-001 + US-006), `tools/overview-viewer/src/components/TaskCommand.tsx` (US-001 + US-003), `tools/overview-viewer/vite.config.ts` (US-005), `tools/overview-viewer/src/__tests__/testData.ts` (US-001); exclusive=`RalphStageChip.tsx` (US-002), `Toolbar.tsx` (US-004), `overview.html` (US-005), downstream plan markdown (US-007); risk=high (signature changes ripple through every consumer).
- `execution_mode` rationale: Serial because each story either depends on the previous (US-001 unblocks US-003 + US-006; US-005 unblocks US-006's HMR fetch) or shares files (`App.tsx`, `TaskCommand.tsx`, `vite.config.ts`). Concurrent edits would require constant rebasing on `tools/overview-viewer/src/App.tsx` and `useMultiAxisFilter.ts`. A second crew member is already editing `vite.config.ts` for Plan 02 — adding a third parallel author would multiply the conflict surface.

Parallel handoff: `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan <plan_job_dir>/plan.md --parallel --suggested-decomposition <plan_job_dir>/suggested-decomposition.json` (this plan recommends serial; the parallel handoff is preserved for orchestrator schema compatibility but the suggested-decomposition.json defines only a single serial cluster, so parallel mode would just run it serially anyway).

The plan-review loop fixed all 4 High findings (F-001..F-004). 7 Medium findings remained open at the start of iteration 5 and the loop soft-capped — they are logged here so the implementer can fold them into US-* execution.

3. **F-005 [Medium · Feasibility]** — `overviewRalphStatePlugin().transformIndexHtml` should fail-fast if `<script src="./overview-ralph-state.js"></script>` is missing in `overview.html`, mirroring the existing `overviewDataPlugin` guard in `tools/overview-viewer/vite.config.ts`. Add an explicit `if (!html.includes(ralphSidecarScriptTag)) throw new Error(...)` before the replace.
4. **F-006 [Medium · Simplicity]** — Drop `role="button"` on the chip trigger (no click action exists). Keep `tabIndex={0}` and add `aria-label={`Ralph stage: ${stage}`}` + `onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}` so it stays focusable, screen-reader-friendly, and does not toggle the parent `<summary>` row.
5. **F-007 [Medium · Completeness]** — Add explicit positive-coverage unit tests for `matchesTaskFilter` / `matchesKanbanFilter` with a populated `OverviewRalphState`: filter set, task matches → included; filter set, task doesn't match → excluded. NO_RALPH_STATE backward-compat alone does not prove the new predicate works.
6. **F-008 [Medium · Ordering]** — F-001 is now resolved by exposing `setFilters` up-front, which makes most of US-007 redundant for the Plan 04 hook contract. US-007 still owns the Plan-04..12 + INDEX cascade audit, but the hook-contract piece can be checked at the start of US-001 with a 30-second read of `plans/ralph-pipeline-04-pipeline-overview.md`.
7. **F-009 [Medium · Criteria Quality]** — Replace the "tasks without are visually byte-identical to pre-feature" acceptance line with concrete DOM assertions: `RalphStageChip` returns null for missing entries; `document.querySelectorAll('[data-task-id="<id>"] .ralph-stage-chip').length === 0` for untracked tasks; existing commandList/kanban snapshot tests remain unchanged.
8. **F-010 [Medium · Criteria Quality]** — Reword the dev-server fetch criterion: do not hardcode `127.0.0.1:5173`. Use either the URL printed by `pnpm overview` or add `strictPort: true` to vite.config so the port is guaranteed. Same applies to any other localhost URL in acceptance criteria.
9. **F-011 [Medium · Completeness]** — Sharpen the `loadRalphState()` contract: reads `plans/overview-ralph-state.js` synchronously via `readFileSync`, executes via the synthetic-window pattern from F-002's resolution, returns the resulting `OverviewRalphState`, and returns `NO_RALPH_STATE` (does not throw) if the file is missing.
